## Lacunae — *Fallout: Equestria – Project Horizons*

Lacunae is the mournful, minigun-wielding purple alicorn who joins Blackjack in Somber’s [*Project Horizons*](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons). She belongs to that fan-fiction continuity, not the *Friendship Is Magic* television storyline. Her crucial identity twist is **Psalm**: the pre-war unicorn whose body and mind were absorbed into Unity. Lacunae becomes a distinct personality formed from the painful memories and feelings the Goddess discards; after Unity falls, Psalm returns. She resembles Princess Luna but is not Luna.

**Look and name.** Tall dusky-purple mare, dark blue mane, violet eyes, black mourning/lace dress concealing her wings, and often a levitated heavy minigun. “Lacunae” is the name she gives Blackjack in the story, not a fan-assigned background-pony name; the word suggests gaps or missing pieces, fitting her role as Unity’s repository for unwanted memories.

**Speech and appearances.** She converses frequently, usually by telepathy without moving her mouth, but can speak aloud when the psychic link fails ([Ch. 26, “Descent”](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/26)). She is a recurring *Project Horizons* character, not a G4 television-episode appearance; no official TV voice actor or episode timestamp applies.

**Verified fan art:** Kitana762 depicts her magic and minigun; PaintedHooves depicts her dark dress (the latter artwork interprets the mane color more lightly).

## Important moments

1. **A name and a mission — Ch. 19, “EC-1101.”** She introduces herself to Blackjack as “Lacunae” and reveals Unity’s interest in recruiting her. [Read the chapter](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/19).
2. **Saving Blackjack — Ch. 23, “Walkabout.”** After the catastrophe in Stable 99, Lacunae pulls Blackjack out of deadly chlorine exposure and tries to ease her anguish through shared memories. [Read the chapter](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/23).
3. **Saving Scotch Tape — Ch. 37, “Winning and Losing.”** When the filly begins producing chlorine gas in her lungs, Lacunae immediately teleports her and Glory to emergency surgery. [Read the chapter](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/37).
4. **Choosing compassion over Unity — Ch. 58, “Departures.”** She challenges the Goddess’s rejection of painful feelings, then returns stolen memories to the alicorns despite knowing it will end her distinct existence. [Read the chapter](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/58).
5. **Psalm’s second chance — Ch. 70, “Calm.”** The restored Psalm tells Blackjack that possessing Lacunae’s memories does not make her Lacunae, distinguishing the two identities. [Read the chapter](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/71).

*These are prose chapters, not TV episodes; verified full-episode video timestamps are unavailable.*
